text: A database is an organised collection of data that allows you to store, search, and manage information easily. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, which makes them great for structured data. NoSQL databases are more flexible and work well with changing or unstructured data. To get information from a database, you write queries. Good data modeling helps you plan how your data connects before you build anything. Indexes make searches much faster because they work like a book's index. Choosing the right database depends on your needs.
